item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The broad trough of low pressure now bringing showers to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea will weaken in the next couple of days. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will become fine and very hot over southeastern China in the latter part of this week to early next week, but there will still be one or two showers.

Date/Month: 31/07 (Wednesday)
Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. More showers at first. Sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
